title: Across the chasm
description: Audio designer Ben Burtt had created a library of sounds that Lucas referred to as an "organic soundtrack." For Chewbacca's growls, Burtt recorded and combined sounds made by dogs, bears, lions, tigers, and walruses, to create phrases and sentences. The robotic voice of C-3PO was achieved by filtering voices through an electronic synthesizer. Always inventive, Burtt implanted a microphone within a scuba tank mask to accomplish Darth Vader's heavy breathing. The actual voice of Vader actor David Prowse was never intended to be used; Lucas originally considered Orson Welles for this major performance, but ultimately chose the then-less-recognizable James Earl Jones.
